phantom_stampede.name: Lightfoot Pack
phantom_stampede.desc: Fast wolves leave a trail of light that bleeds what crosses it.
phantom_stampede.codex: Wolves do not chase. They wait, they leap, they hold.

howling_legion.name: Howling Legion
howling_legion.desc: Prey your pack fells rises to run with it.
howling_legion.codex: Nothing the pack takes stays fallen.

dire_alpha.name: The Alpha
dire_alpha.desc: One great wolf: a crushing bite that bleeds all beside it, with two ghost shades hunting on.

murder_storm.name: Wall of Wings
murder_storm.desc: Two rings of ravens circle you in opposite ways: what touches them is pecked, and the rest flee.
murder_storm.codex: A murder does not hunt. It refuses.

dive_bombers.name: Talon Mark
dive_bombers.desc: Ravens dive at the toughest foe and mark it: everything you have hits it 15% harder for 3 s.
dive_bombers.codex: They choose the largest shadow and fall on it.

spearhead.name: Spearhead
spearhead.desc: A wedge of ravens flies into the thickest crowd and clears a lane.
spearhead.codex: Where the wedge flies, the crowd remembers a road.

spirit_tempest.name: Spirit Tempest
spirit_tempest.desc: Eight glyphs burst out, each finds its own foe and pops on every hit.
spirit_tempest.codex: Eight lights, eight names, none wasted.

soul_lance.name: Soul Lance
soul_lance.desc: A lance of light through the thickest line of foes, leaving a burning script line.
soul_lance.codex: One light, spoken through all of them.

thunder_judgment.name: Thunder Judgment
thunder_judgment.desc: Every 3 s the sky smites the 30 nearest foes around you. Your chain still jumps 9 times.
thunder_judgment.codex: The sky keeps its own count.

returning_pages.name: Returning Pages
returning_pages.desc: Glyphs fly out through the crowd and home again through fresh foes.
returning_pages.codex: Every name read out comes home to the page.

static_storm.name: Static Storm
static_storm.desc: A living field strikes several foes at once, fresh ones first. More Chains, more strikes.
static_storm.codex: The air itself takes your side.

storm_tether.name: Storm Tether
storm_tether.desc: Held arcs of lightning: one per two Chains, each forking once. Arc sets their reach.
storm_tether.codex: Vane never lets go of a storm.

vesper_tide.name: Vesper Tide
vesper_tide.desc: The ring swells out and draws back, striking hard on every swell.
vesper_tide.codex: At evening the light breathes, and the dark steps back.

sanctum_halo.name: Sanctum Halo
sanctum_halo.desc: A wide ring of candles; the ground inside it burns.
sanctum_halo.codex: Where the candles walk, the Hollow cannot stand.

judgement_wheel.name: Judgement Wheel
judgement_wheel.desc: Lights burst on contact, then rekindle.
judgement_wheel.codex: Each light is a verdict, spoken once.
